scope: development-only robust raw-measurement quality-control candidate for the smartphone native SPP fallback
purpose: Test one physically predeclared standardized innovation weighting scheme against the exact frozen handset WLS reference without using truth-derived thresholds.

frozen_split.selection_basis: route-disjoint central-directory metadata and the already frozen feasibility audit

input_contract.adapter_policy: retain the existing finite, signal/frequency/constellation, ADR/clock, timestamp, and RINEX contracts; no truth is passed to preprocessing

candidate.algorithm: native SPP uncertainty-weighted iterative WLS with standardized residual Huber downweighting after the initial solve; existing residual outlier rejection and leave-one-out RAIM/FDE remain enabled
candidate.scheme_rationale: Huber's 3-sigma standardized-innovation rule is a fixed robust-statistics convention; the 0.05 floor prevents deleting a measurement and preserves solver fallback behavior. No route, device, or truth-trained threshold is introduced.
candidate.fallback: if robust SPP has invalid geometry, rank deficiency, nonfinite solution, or process failure, publish the exact current Android WLS POS for that epoch; never extrapolate or synthesize a position
candidate.atomic_contract: run solver in a private staging directory, validate finite POS keys against device epochs, then atomically publish POS, summary, and manifest; partial artifacts are not promoted

features: standardized raw pseudorange innovation proxy after per-epoch clock-centering
satellite count and line-of-sight geometry condition/GDOP proxy
truth_free_observable_audit.truth_join_policy: optional post-freeze train-only join; error labels are never used to set a threshold or alter an artifact
truth_free_observable_audit.sentinel_policy: non-finite Android sentinel values are counted as unavailable and never used as numeric quality values

gates.train: all three route-level H P50/P95, V P95, availability, truth coverage, and four local Kaggle diagnostic variants non-regressed versus exact WLS; require strict aggregate H P95 and diagnostic-mean improvement
gates.fresh_validation: open only after all train gates pass and truth-free artifacts are sealed; require per-route and aggregate non-regression plus strict aggregate H P95 improvement
gates.future_holdout: remain unopened unless fresh validation passes; one truth read only after truth-free artifacts are sealed; no post-holdout tuning or rerun
gates.vertical: V P95 must remain at or below the frozen profile threshold (45 m) and may not have a major regression of more than 5 m versus the WLS reference
gates.availability_and_coverage: non-regression; invalid robust epochs may use exact WLS fallback but no new keys may be synthesized
gates.promotion: development-only raw-quality native SPP fallback; production RTK/SPP and recommended smartphone WLS lane remain unchanged

bounded_alternative_if_no_go.precondition: attempt only after robust candidate has a sealed train No-Go
bounded_alternative_if_no_go.scope: inspect existing Ceres/GTSAM/factor-graph dependencies and Android observation adapters; no new estimator rewrite, no truth-based wiring decisions
bounded_alternative_if_no_go.success_definition: compile/test-only adapter feasibility with explicit missing dependency or supported factor contract
